results.explanation: At the declared ShareLinkViewSet.create entry, the viewset applies IsAuthenticated and PaperlessObjectPermissions, and its POST permission map requires add_sharelink for the ShareLink model. That governs authorization to create the share-link object, not by itself authorization to view the referenced document. The create flow uses PassUserMixin, which supplies request.user to SerializerWithPerms serializers. ShareLinkSerializer.validate_document then requires both the global documents.view_document permission and has_perms_owner_aware(user, "view_document", document). The latter permits an owner or an object-level permission; for a document owned by another user with no object-level grant, it is false. Therefore the global view_document grant does not substitute for the owner-aware target-document check, validation raises PermissionDenied, and the share-link creation is denied under the supplied premises.

def has_perms_owner_aware(user, perms, obj):
    """
    Legacy slow path (guardian-backed) single-object permission check.

    The queryset-filtering side of this migrated onto
    ``PermittedObjectsFilter``/``permitted_object_ids()``, but this
    single-object check still has many production callers. Several callers
    remain across ``documents/``, ``paperless_mail/``, and ``paperless_ai/``
    -- grep for this function name before removing it.
    """
    checker = ObjectPermissionChecker(user)
    return obj.owner is None or obj.owner == user or checker.has_perm(perms, obj)
